sections.text: The tide is rising through an abandoned archive. Its final catalogue may hold the names of a town lost beneath the sea.

options.description: Wade directly into the flooded stacks

consequence.text: The cold water leaves you shaking.

options.description: Look for a skiff along the quay

sections.text: A skiff floats beside a sheltered entrance. The harbor road remains clear if you decide to abandon the search.
Loose shelves form a narrow bridge to the catalogue room. Behind you, the quay is still visible through the entrance.

options.description: Cross the shelves to the catalogue

consequence.text: A shelf collapses and bruises your ribs.

sections.text: The catalogue points toward a dry bell chamber and a submerged vault. A rescue kit hangs near the chamber door.

options.description: Take the rescue kit into the bell chamber
Dive straight into the submerged vault

consequence.text: The dive leaves you short of breath.

sections.text: A sealed copy of the catalogue rests beside the bell. A lower stair leads toward the original records.

options.description: Carry the sealed catalogue to safety

consequence.text: A rusted step cuts your leg.

sections.text: Water presses against the vault door. A damaged return channel leads back toward the harbor.

options.description: Force the vault door and retrieve the records

consequence.text: The rushing water slams you against the wall.

sections.text: The archive's names return to the town registry. Families gather to read the stories that the tide almost erased.
You reach the harbor and warn the archivists about the rising water. They begin planning a safer expedition.
